analysis: v2.1 H6 note-availability missing-storetime fallback freeze

selection_rule.population: storetime-present normalized bedside notes eligible under the registered primary availability rule in the union of registered MetaVision populations
selection_rule.rounding: ceil to next whole hour; minimum 1 hour

consequence: Because no normalized bedside note in the registered admissions lacked storetime, storetime-only and 3-hour fallback sensitivities are empirically identical to the primary note-availability rule; no semantic or predictive rerun is required.
guardrails: Freeze derived from label-free timing data before note-availability outcome-performance inspection.
No outcome performance informed the fallback value.
Row-level timing and note text remain local.
